Consider the following C program

int Dosomething(struct treenode *root , int sum)
{
    if(root==NULL)
      return sum;
    sum = Dosomething(root -> left, sum);
    sum = Dosomething(root -> right, sum);
    if(root -> data%2)
       sum/=root -> data;
    else
       sum*=root -> data;
    return sum;
}

Consider the pseudocode given below. The function Dosomething takes an argument a pointer to the root of an arbitrary tree which uses a queue data structure $Q$.

int Dosomething(struct Node *node)
{
   if(node != NULL)
   {
        Enque(Q,node);
        while (Q is not empty)
       {
            struct Node *temp = Deque(Q);
            if (!temp -> left && temp -> right || temp -> left && !temp -> right)
               count++;
            if (temp -> left != NULL)
               Enque(Q,temp -> left);
            if (temp -> right != NULL)
               Enque(Q,temp -> right);
        }
   }
  return count;
}
